skill.displayName: Hemp CBD Video — Product Education and Brand Building Videos for Hemp and CBD Companies
skill.summary: Creates educational videos for hemp and CBD brands to explain products, dosing, lab testing, extraction methods, and farm-to-bottle stories to build trust.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the hemp-cbd-video skill.
- Assists hemp, CBD, and botanical wellness brands in creating short product education and brand-building videos.
- Supports video topics such as product education, dosing guides, COA walkthroughs, extraction methods, and farm-to-bottle stories.
- Aims to help brands build trust, educate skeptical consumers, and increase confident first-time purchases.
